question.text: What will Argentina's month-on-month inflation (INDEC national CPI) be for October 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the month-on-month percentage variation of Argentina's national Consumer Price Index ("Nivel general", total national coverage) for October 2026 as published by INDEC (Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos). The resolving figure is the one reported for October 2026 in INDEC's IPC press release, scheduled for 16:00 ART (UTC−3) on Thursday 12 November 2026 per INDEC's dissemination calendar, and displayed as "Precios al consumidor (IPC)" on INDEC's prices page: https://www.indec.gob.ar/indec/web/Nivel3-Tema-3-5. Answers are expressed in percent: a published monthly variation of 1,9% resolves as 1.9, and a published variation of 2,0% resolves as 2.0. If INDEC's own publication is unavailable or not rendered on that page, the INDEC figure as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.
question.fine_print: Only the national-total monthly variation of the general index counts; the core ("núcleo") reading, regional breakdowns, and the year-on-year or year-to-date figures do not affect resolution. The first October 2026 figure INDEC publishes is used. If INDEC delays the release beyond 12 November 2026, the question remains open and resolves once the figure is published.

research:
Last checked 2026-11-02. The October 2026 figure has not been published. Private estimates mostly fall between 1.8% and 2.0%, and the markets point to 1.8% to 2.0% as the likeliest outcome.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: I fetched INDEC's prices page (Nivel3-Tema-3-5), but the content that came back was only menus and footer text, with no IPC number. So I could not confirm the latest value directly on the page. [INDEC](https://www.indec.gob.ar/indec/web/Nivel3-Tema-3-5)
- 2026-10-13 (from the question background, not checked by me): September 2026 was 1.9% m/m, 33.4% y/y and 23.6% so far in 2026. Core was 1.8%.
- INDEC's calendar puts the October release on 2026-11-12 at 16:00 ART (from the question background).

## 2. Current status
- No official October figure exists yet, and nothing so far settles the question.
- 2026-11-01: The only official partial-month reading I found is from Córdoba province. Its IETSE institute put Córdoba's October inflation at 1.83%, down from 2.08% in September. This is a provincial index, not INDEC's. [Perfil](https://www.perfil.com/cordoba/la-inflacion-bajo-a-183-en-octubre-pero-al-caer-las-ventas-cerraron-263-comercios-en-cordoba-ayoa80w8YUZI)
- I did not find Buenos Aires City (CABA) October data. It usually comes out a few days before INDEC.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-02, Infobae survey of private estimates:
  - Libertad y Progreso 1.8%, Equilibra 1.8%, EconViews 1.9%.
  - Analytica, Invecq and C&T about 2%, EcoGo 2.1%.
  - Analytica: food and beverages rose 0.4% in the fourth week of October and 2.5% over four weeks (vegetables +8.8%).
  - The BCRA says the late-September gasoline increases (1% to 5%) will hit October in full. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/economia/2026/11/02/que-esperan-las-consultoras-privadas-para-el-dato-de-inflacion-de-octubre/)
- 2026-11-02: Clarín and Minutouno (from the news API summaries) report a range of 1.6% to 1.9% and call it a "slight slowdown". I could not open Clarín to find who estimated 1.6%. [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/economia/alimentos-presionaron-inflacion-octubre-calculan-ipc-debajo-2_0_aP4nbY8LC2.html), [Minutouno](https://www.minutouno.com/economia/precios-la-suba-los-alimentos-fogoneo-la-inflacion-octubre-y-sumo-presion-al-bolsillo-n6340462)
- 2026-11-01, La Nación:
  - Equilibra 1.8%: seasonal items +2.7%, regulated prices +1.8%, beef +0.1%.
  - Libertad y Progreso 1.8%: food +2.1%, housing slowed from 3.1% to 1.1%, transport rose from 1.5% to 2.7%.
  - LCG 1.8%: food above 2.5%.
  - EcoGo 1.8% preliminary, which could be revised up 0.1 to 0.2 points because of changes to gas subsidies in cold regions.
  - Analytica 2%, Empiria 2%, EconViews and C&T "similar to September". [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/estiman-que-la-inflacion-de-octubre-se-habria-ubicado-entre-el-18-y-el-2-nid01112026/)
- 2026-10-31: Milei said "inflation is falling more slowly". The government and the BCRA flagged beef, utility tariffs and fuel as year-end pressures (Clarín, from the news API summary). [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/economia/gobierno-adelanta-sale-decir-carne-tarifas-naftas-nuevas-presiones-inflacion-fin-ano_0_pATpNxjY1M.html)
- 2026-10-30: LCG's survey had food up 4.4% over four weeks, with six straight weekly increases. [PlanB](https://www.planbnoticias.com.ar/index.php/2026/10/30/inflacion-consultoras-anticipan-que-cerrara-cerca-del-2-y-los-alimentos-subieron-hasta-el-4/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026 monthly readings: Jan 2.9, Feb 2.9, Mar 3.4, Apr 2.6, May 2.1, Jun 1.9, Jul 2.1, Aug 1.7, Sep 1.9.
- Since May, every month has been between 1.7% and 2.1%. The month-to-month change has been about ±0.2 to 0.4 points.
- Track record of private consensus: the 2026 monthly REM medians found in this research were 2.0% for both June and July, against prints of 1.9% and 2.1%. That suggests consensus errors of about ±0.1 to 0.3 points. I did not do a systematic check.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi (2026-11-02): implied probability of above 1.6% is 0.92, above 1.8% is 0.59, above 2.0% is 0.23 and above 2.2% is 0.12. Exactly how Kalshi defines "above" for a value equal to the threshold should be checked.
- Polymarket (same contract question):
  - 1.6% to 1.8%: 0.48
  - 1.9% to 2.1%: 0.37
  - 2.2% to 2.4%: 0.06
  - 2.5% to 2.7%: 0.04
  - 1.3% to 1.5%: 0.03
- BCRA REM: the September survey had a median of 1.7% for October. The August REM also had 1.7%. [La Gaceta / REM coverage](https://www.lagaceta.com.ar/nota/1111647/economia/analistas-consultados-bcra-proyectaron-inflacion-octubre-se-ubicaria-torno-al-22porciento.html), [NoticiasNQN](https://www.noticiasnqn.com.ar/amp/noticias/2026/08/06/346909-el-bcra-proyecta-inflacion-por-debajo-del-2por_ciento-y-un-dolar-a-1652-para-fin-de-2026)
- The La Gaceta headline mentions "2.2% for October" but appears to be from 2025, so it is not relevant.
- I could not find the October REM yet.
- Spread of private estimates: about 1.8% to 2.1%, with most at 1.8%. One press report gives a low of 1.6%.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Around 2026-11-05 to 06: the BCRA's October REM, with an updated median.
- Around 2026-11-07 to 11: CABA's October CPI, a useful early signal, plus other provincial indices.
- 2026-11-12, 16:00 ART: INDEC releases the October IPC.
- Main risks in the data:
  - Upside: food and vegetables, gas subsidy changes in cold regions (EcoGo's +0.1 to 0.2 point risk), and fuel.
  - Downside: no large tariff jumps (housing slowed) and flat beef prices.

  - Analytica: food +0.8% in the third week of October, 2.6% on a four-week average, with vegetables +10.6%.
  - LCG: food +0.5% that week, the seventh straight weekly rise, with a four-week average of 3.8%.

## 4. Base rates
- 2026 monthly prints: Jan 2.9, Feb 2.9, Mar 3.4, Apr 2.6, May 2.1, Jun 1.9, Jul 2.1, Aug 1.7, Sep 1.9. From June to September the readings stayed between 1.7 and 2.1, and the month-to-month change was 0.2 points each time.
- Consultora consensus vs. actual: the August consensus was about 1.5% to 1.8% and the actual print was 1.7%. [Contexto Tucumán](https://www.contextotucuman.com/nota/410383/la-inflacion-se-desacelera-por-la-carne-la-nafta-y-el-dolar-durante-agosto-estaria-entre-1-5_por_ciento-y-1-8_por_ciento.html) Historically, misses of about 0.1 to 0.3 points in either direction are typical.
- For comparison, October 2025 was 2.3% nationally and 2.2% in CABA. [Diario de Cuyo](https://www.diariodecuyo.com.ar/argentina/inflacion-de-octubre-estiman-que-se-acercaria-a-24-1796960.html)

- The August REM also had 1.7% for October and 1.6% for November.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Early November (around 5 to 6 November): the BCRA publishes its October REM, with an updated October median. I could not confirm the exact date.
- Around 7 to 10 November: CABA's statistics office (IDECBA) publishes its October CPI, usually a few days before INDEC. It is a useful signal and has tracked the national print closely in 2026. I did not find a 2026 CABA October estimate.
- Weekly food price trackers (LCG, Analytica, EconViews) publish closing October data.
- 2026-11-12, 16:00 ART: INDEC releases the October IPC.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 10 days. INDEC publishes the October 2026 IPC on 12 November 2026 at 16:00 ART.

(b) The latest value is September 2026 at 1.9% m/m, published 13 October 2026. Core was 1.8%.

(c) If nothing changed, October would print about 1.9%.

(d) If the trend continued, it would be about 1.8 to 1.9%. Prints since May have stayed flat around 1.7 to 2.1%, so disinflation has stalled. The provincial index for Córdoba eased from 2.08% to 1.83%, which points slightly lower.

(e) Historical variation: since May, consecutive months have moved by about ±0.2 to 0.4 points. Consensus errors are around ±0.1 to 0.3 points.

(f) Experts and markets:
- **Private consultoras:** 1.8 to 2.1%, with the cluster at 1.8 to 2.0%. One press report gives a low of 1.6%.
- **BCRA REM (September survey):** median of 1.7%, but taken before October prices were observed.
- **Kalshi:** P(≥1.7) is about 0.92, P(≥1.9) about 0.59 and P(≥2.1) about 0.23.
- **Polymarket:** 1.6 to 1.8% at 0.48, 1.9 to 2.1% at 0.37, and 2.2% or higher at about 0.10.
- **Implied median:** about 1.9.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- **Low:** the strong food and vegetable surveys overstate INDEC's measure, while services and housing slow sharply and beef stays flat. The print would be 1.5 to 1.6%.
- **High:** the gas subsidy changes in cold regions, the full effect of the fuel increases and food rising more than 2.5% all feed through together. The print would be 2.2 to 2.4%.
